title: The APT Foundation donates $120,000 to UNICEF to provide COVID 19 vaccines.
author: Emma
body:
Since October last year, the APT Foundation has been actively fundraising in support of UNICEF’s Give the World a Shot Campaign. The APT Foundation has a long-standing partnership with UNICEF Australia, and the fund was eager to support the charity once again in bringing lifesaving COVID-19 vaccines to the most vulnerable communities across the globe.

On 28 April at ATG’s VIP event in Sydney, company Co-Owner and Director, Robert McGeary was delighted to hand over a cheque for $120,000. The substantial donation will help to vaccinate over 24,000 individuals against COVID-19 and was a result of a number of the APT Foundation’s initiatives, including matching every public contribution over $50 dollar-for-dollar made through the APT Foundation website, and donating $20 on behalf of every APT staff member who received their second vaccine.

The APT Foundation is proud to have made such a meaningful contribution to vaccine equality and to have surpassed its original fundraising goal of $100,000. With the help of organisations like the APT Foundation, UNICEF has delivered over 1 billion vaccines to 144 countries so far, reaching individuals in need who would never have received testing or treatment without UNICEF’s help.


The APT Foundation would like to extend a thank you to all who donated so generously, together we can achieve vaccine equality.
